wolves.name: Arkan
wolves.biography: He carries the pack’s fear without showing his own. His voice turns hesitation into movement.

wolves.name: Saira
wolves.biography: No broken branch or fading scent escapes her. She hears danger before the forest admits it.

wolves.name: Nora
wolves.biography: Her calm holds the pack together. Even frightened hearts answer when she calls.

wolves.name: Rune
wolves.biography: Curiosity pulls him beyond every safe trail. His strange voice wakes secrets buried in the dark.

wolves.name: Mor
wolves.biography: He survived by misleading stronger enemies. Trust does not come easily to him—or to the pack.

wolves.name: Lumi
wolves.biography: Her frozen echo preserves what the night tries to erase. She walks where ordinary voices disappear.
